text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Dot: median over five real farms injected at 50% of the Primary's pinned capacity. Line: range over the farms. Green band: pre-registered gate (0.95 to 1.05). Dashed line: 0.88, the best two-stage figure. Black tick: the share of the farm that one scale of the fixed solar shape fits (shape ceiling). Fits use rows before 2025-07-01.'
